datasets.name: af56b2ae
queryLines:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT billing_origin_product, SUM(net_list_cost) AS usd
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_dollarized_by_sku_day t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND billing_origin_product IN ('MODEL_SERVING', 'VECTOR_SEARCH')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(usd) FROM p), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       concat('Model serving $', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM p WHERE billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING),
              '; Vector Search $', CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM p WHERE billing_origin_product = 'VECTOR_SEARCH'), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING)) AS target

datasets.name: ceb07005
queryLines:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT is_launch_sku, SUM(net_list_cost) AS usd
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_serving_mode_by_endpoint t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))

)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT usd FROM m WHERE is_launch_sku), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(usd) FROM m), 0), 0) AS value,

datasets.name: ec78e314
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'cost_by_serving_endpoint', 'Spend by serving endpoint', 'Spend'),
       (1, 'cost_serving_mode_by_endpoint', 'Serving endpoints over the daily spend limit', 'Spend'),
       (2, 'cost_vector_search_spend', 'Vector Search spend', 'Spend')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: f4def35b
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  CAST(t.`usage_date` AS STRING) AS `usage_date`,
  t.`cloud` AS `cloud`,
  t.`billing_origin_product` AS `billing_origin_product`,
  t.`endpoint_id` AS `endpoint_id`,
  t.`endpoint_name` AS `endpoint_name`,
  t.`usage_type` AS `usage_type`,
  t.`net_usage_quantity` AS `net_usage_quantity`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_by_serving_endpoint t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY `usage_date` DESC NULLS LAST, `endpoint_id` ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

datasets.name: 864819ea
queryLines:
WITH raw AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`workspace_name`, d_workspace.n), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`workspace_name`, d_workspace.n), ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`workspace_name`, d_workspace.n), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
base AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, COALESCE(endpoint_id, endpoint_name) AS ep_key,
         MAX(concat(COALESCE(endpoint_name, endpoint_id), ' . ', COALESCE(nm_workspace, workspace_id))) AS endpoint,
         MAX(endpoint_id) AS endpoint_id, MAX(status) AS status,
         MAX(endpoint_requests_window) AS requests, MAX(est_usd_list) AS usd,
         MAX(tracking_status) AS tracking_status
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY workspace_id, COALESCE(endpoint_id, endpoint_name)
),
err AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, endpoint_id, MAX(error_requests) AS errors
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.serving_endpoint_traffic_by_endpoint
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT (SELECT count_if(requests > 0) FROM base) AS value,
       concat('of ', CAST((SELECT count(*) FROM base) AS STRING), ' endpoints') AS target

ORDER BY CASE b.status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, b.usd DESC

datasets.name: 7804dd9d
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'compute_serving_dormant_endpoints', 'Dormant serving endpoints', 'Endpoints'),
